items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability actively exploited in the wild, allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious PHP code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix on September 7, 2026, for this flaw, which has a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146 (Hotfix for CVE-2026-75650)
items.summary: This critical security update addresses CVE-2026-75650, an actively exploited zero-day vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could lead to unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. Adobe strongly recommends applying the hotfix and rotating encryption keys.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1, as well as security feature bypass and privilege escalation issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. It has a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, that could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges, with a CVSS score of 8.7.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges, with a CVSS score of 7.7.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It has a CVSS score of 7.6.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges, with a CVSS score of 7.5.

items.title: Critical Remote Code Execution vulnerabilities in Amasty extensions
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of its Magento extensions, with two critical vulnerabilities identified that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.
